evidence.lower_domain: rear half x<0; local z below lowest fused LiDAR anchor minus clearance; 3D clearance from measured anchors; fixed hidden proxy; remove reviewed a6 silhouette + 1px and measured depths; require isolated lower alpha and lower PVD fraction
evidence.blocker_depth: isolated lower alpha-weighted camera z minus margin, floor-binned; native raster centers in front of cutoff

ledger.row_index: Persistent index in frozen packed native checkpoint; same gates at every raw frame

footprints.plane: canonical per row; keep side points from target centroid toward protected centroid; plane 30% along their separation
footprints.attribution: Native alpha*T at each row depth; canonical centroids from measured or remaining support and fixed lower rays.

support.plane: canonical per row; keep side points from target centroid toward protected centroid; plane 30% along their separation
support.attribution: Native alpha*T at each row depth; canonical centroids from measured or remaining support and fixed lower rays.

protection_rule: Pass pooled and all 49 frames with depth evidence; increase in RGB MAE and RGB change vs native each <=.003, depth MAE increase <=.03m, alpha >=.99x native.
